item.title: Time for the Pembroke Observer and News weekly photo quiz
item.description: Welcome to the Pembroke Observer and News photo quiz! item.title: Whitewater Region approves $13 million budget
item.description: COBDEN — Whitewater Region (WWR) has a budget to direct its council and staff as they spend just over $13 million to operate the municipality this year. Council approved the draft budget on January 14, which followed a final budget committee meeting lasting just short of three hours. The committee, comprising all council members, began […]

item.title: 'Papa' puts best foot forward in walk for healthcare in Pembroke
item.description: Longtime community supporter Russell Mackay is once again lacing up his walking shoes — and this time, he’s inviting the entire community to join him. item.title: Renfrew County council goes over 2026 budget
item.description: The mayors and reeves of Renfrew County went through that upper-tier level of government’s 2026 budget with a fine-tooth comb this week. County council held its budget workshop Thursday, Jan. 29 where the members were presented with a draft budget containing a proposed 7.9 percent levy increase. item.title: Ottawa snowmobilers charged with speeding in Petawawa by OPP
item.description: PETAWAWA — Two snowmobilers from the Ottawa area have been charged after Upper Ottawa Valley (UOV) Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) officers conducted a speed enforcement exercise on an Ontario Federation of Snowmobile Clubs (OFSC) trail in Petawawa. item.title: Ottawa Valley-filmed ‘Blue Skies on Mars’ set for January 30 release
item.description: Sci‑fi mob drama Blue Skies on Mars releases today, featuring scenes filmed in Pembroke and the Ottawa Valley.
